audience: data engineers who run data pipelines with Estuary Flow

useCases.title: List captures, collections and materializations
useCases.text: The AI lists the catalog entities you can read, filtered by name prefix or type. It shows the connector and last publication of each one.

useCases.title: See how much data a pipeline moved
useCases.text: The AI reads the stats of one catalog entity per time grain: bytes and documents read and written, usage seconds, warnings, errors and failures.

useCases.title: Find out why a publication failed
useCases.text: The AI lists publications with their job status, then reads the log lines of a failed job by its logs token. You see what went wrong.

useCases.title: Browse connectors and their versions
useCases.text: The AI lists the available capture and materialization connectors, can limit them to recommended ones, and shows the versions with documentation links.

useCases.title: Stage a catalog change and validate it
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft, adds a spec to it and publishes with dry_run on to validate it. Turning dry_run off applies the change to live pipelines.
